bibl.title: Changes in Urban and Sacred Landscapes of Memphis in the Third to the Fourth Centuries AD and the Eclipse of the Divine Apis Bulls.
bibl.seg: Nenad Marković, Changes in Urban and Sacred Landscapes of Memphis in the Third to the Fourth Centuries AD and the Eclipse of the Divine Apis Bulls.
bibl.note: All evidence suggests a strong possibility that the selection of Apis bulls was suspended during the third century AD, most likely the result of lack of funding and gradual changes in state policy towards traditional cults, as well as the shift in private religious sentiments of the local population.
